name: Kagura
description: A point-light dancer: fifteen warm-white points on near-black at the joints of one human body, each dragging a 0.4 s amber trail, dancing the twist in place. The dance is CMU motion capture time-warped onto the cached beat grid, so every hip-turn extreme lands on a beat, from a continuous beat position computed from the grid's beat times and the playback clock at render rate. The two twist clips alternate on bar lines (every 4 beats when the grid declines the bar) with a one-beat crossfade. With no grid, or on the streaming path until the beat tracker locks, the figure sways instead, unwarped and never frozen. Nothing brightens on the beat: the beat moves the pose. KAG.2, uncertified; dance selection, arm reach and the silence rest arrive in KAG.3. See docs/presets/KAGURA_DESIGN.md.
author: Matt
